one_liner: Senior legislative liaison for the Pentagon's Special Access Program office, handling Congressional Defense Committee inquiries and shaping SAP policy for top DoD leaders.
fit_summary: GS-15 requires a year of GS-14-level experience developing and implementing special access program policy, plus SCI eligibility. Daniel's resume (emergency management and public health operations at IEM, no clearance listed) doesn't come close, so treat this only as a picture of senior policy work.
eligibility: Open to the public (hiring paths include public, vets, military spouses and transitioning feds), so no federal status is needed.

Specialized experience: one year at the GS-14 equivalent applying complex legislative and regulatory guidance to policy, developing and implementing special access program policies and procedures, and using qualitative and/or quantitative methods to assess program effectiveness.
Security clearance: Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI), with a full background investigation.

Education cannot be substituted for experience. All qualifications must be met by the November 6, 2026 closing date and documented in a resume of two pages or less, with months and hours per week listed.
strategy: Skip it: his resume shows no special access program policy work, so he can't truthfully claim the specialized experience.

Put the effort into better-fitting roles instead: GS-9 to GS-12 congressional affairs or legislative analyst jobs, FEMA or DHS program analyst roles, Virginia state agency jobs and Hill staff positions, where his IEM background and policy interest are a stronger match.
resume_bullets: Tracked state implementation of the Rural Health Transformation Program from November 2025, identifying which states were executing well and which were struggling.
Took minutes at a large travel company's weekly meetings (Feb – Aug 2024).
interview_questions: Describe a time you managed a sensitive inquiry from a congressional office or senior official under a tight deadline.

watch_outs: The SAP policy experience requirement likely disqualifies you, and the SCI requirement means a full background investigation.
The job is fully on-site at the Pentagon, with no telework or remote option.
There is a USA Hire assessment, and inflated questionnaire answers can remove you from consideration.
